review_pass_1: Internal scientific and scope review against two CSIR syllabi, archived MP SET, approved roadmap, primary records and reviews. Checked EIN2 positive ORE1 and negative miR164 arms, NAC distinction, ABA guard-cell versus AtNAP/SAG113 stage specificity, AHK3–ARR2 and IPT negative feedback, JA and SA context, PIF4/PIF5, individual versus whole-plant darkness, N concentration versus amount, ROS signal versus injury, and functional versus cosmetic retention. Recomputed 60%, 4 µg cm⁻² day⁻¹, day 8, 22, 8-fold, 12→48 RNA units, 10→3 mg N, 70% loss, 5/7=71.43%, Fv/Fm 0.8 and 0.6, daily light integrals 8.64/17.28, sugar interaction 33.
review_pass_2: Separate internal teaching/assessment and static technical review. Compared with published 5.D.01 (14,651 teaching words, 148 paragraphs) and found no exact paragraph overlap; draft 14,104 words, 155 distinct paragraphs, maximum pairwise word-set Jaccard 0.239 as a screening metric only. Re-fetched saved HTML, checked 52 keys against choices, balanced positions, 13 SVG title/desc/zoom controls, unique IDs and anchors, tag balance, preserved reader shell and dynamic navigation. Corrected figure numbering and added origins of all 18 misconceptions. No external expert or independent browser test.

quality.assessment: Two internal editorial passes, not external peer review.
